canonical_0x5d4b100.role: chain-walk continuation: advances past the node it was called on, compares eight more levels' vtable slot 24 against itself, calls the ninth level's slot 24 unconditionally (recursing when that slot is canonical too)

dispatch_rule: compare each level's vtable slot 24 (offset 0xc0) against the canonical 0x5d4b100; the first level whose slot 24 differs has THAT slot called with (bool_out, node, value_out); if every compared level matches, advance one more node and call ITS slot 24 unconditionally

emulated_slot24_0x6025eb0.contract: (bool_out, node, value_out): zeroes the out triple {u32 code, u16 code2, ptr}; when node+0x48 is set, value_out = *(node+0x30) and the scaled +0x40 add runs; when clear, recurses to *(node+0x20) with a temp triple, merges it into out, then runs the scaled add when the merged code is 0

entry_installers.form: mode 0 (edx == 0): install the thunk's vtable at (%rdi); mode 1 (edx == 1): store rsi at (%rdi); any other mode: return 0 unchanged

got_canonical.second_slot_note: 0x64cde48 is not a GOT slot: it is slot 24 of the SystemClockWrapper vtable in .data.rel.ro. No instruction in the node binary loads 0x64cde48 itself (no RIP-relative load targets it; the full-disassembly search and the qword scan find nothing); the slot is read only through virtual dispatch at vtable offset 0xc0 on a SystemClockWrapper object, by the resolver, the canonical's own recursion, and the four lea sites.

open_unknowns: Why the SystemClockWrapper vtable's slots 0, 1 and 14 are null while the subclass EmulatedSystemClock fills slots 0-1 with its wrapper-installing destructors and slot 14 with 0x60257a0: recorded as observed, not explained.

What the four lea-site host functions (0x5dc9d70, 0x5e18d20, 0x5f7d7d0, 0x5f865d0) do after the first use of the dispatch result: their tails (shared_ptr releases, vector push-backs, loops) are cited with callees in the excerpts, not modeled.

Which of the wrapper vtable's other slot functions (0x609d760, 0x609dc40, 0x5d32560, 0x5fcf590, 0x6096790, 0x5d2e090, 0x60956f0, 0x609d0e0, 0x60986b0, 0x6095710, 0x5fcdae0, 0x609d980, 0x5d32a30, 0x5d2e770, 0x5fcc3f0, 0x5d2ca10, 0x5d4d490, 0x5fcc340, 0x5fcc360, 0x5fcc380, 0x5dd41a0, 0x5fcc3a0) each implement: only their addresses and FDE ranges are pinned here.

The exact roles of the five vtable installers beyond the shared vptr install (copy vs move vs destructor): V2/V5 are EmulatedSystemClock vtable slots 0-1; V1/V3/V4 have one direct caller each or none, and their field copies/releases are in the excerpts, not modeled.
The qword copies of the canonical address at file offsets 0x10f9f0 and 0x15d270 sit inside .eh_frame data, not code: no instruction references them.
The entry thunks' mode-1 arm stores rsi verbatim; which caller passes what pointer there is not traced.

resolver_0x5f074e0.role: lazy one-time resolver: owner+0xcb8 is read first (-1 returns at once is false; any other value returns at once), four levels compared inline against the canonical, fifth level's slot 24 called unconditionally with (bool_out, node, value_out)

A.dispatch_args: rdi = bool_out at -0xd0(%rbp), rsi = terminal node, rdx = ptr_out at -0xd8(%rbp)
A.first_use: bool nonzero -> 0x5dca750; else ptr_out stored to -0x110(%rbp) and *(arg+0x38) nonzero -> 0x5dca6f8
A.pre_walk: SIMD sum of the +0x10 field over the pointer range [*(arg8+0xa98), *(arg8+0xa98)+8)

B.dispatch_args: rdi = bool_out at 0x30(%rsp), rsi = terminal node, rdx = ptr_out at 0x20(%rsp)
B.first_use: bool nonzero or ptr_out < *(obj+0x438) -> 0x5e19038; else ptr_out -= *(obj+0x438) >> 1

C.dispatch_args: rdi = bool_out at 0x50(%rsp), rsi = terminal node, rdx = ptr_out at 0x38(%rsp)
C.first_use: bool nonzero or ptr_out < arg3 -> 0x5f7daec; else ptr_out -= arg3
C.prologue: *(arg1+0xc88) zeroed when set; *(arg1+0xd20) synced to *(arg1+0xd18) when they differ

D.dispatch_args: rdi = bool_out at -0x100(%rbp), rsi = terminal node, rdx = ptr_out at -0x128(%rbp)
D.first_use: bool nonzero -> 0x5f86fcc; else ptr_out stored to -0x1a0(%rbp) and the pair iteration begins
D.pre_walk: stack config built: 1 at -0x68(%rbp), 0 at -0x60/-0x58, 1.0f (0x3f800000) at -0x50, 0 at -0x48/-0x40

vtable_installers.form: lea the vtable header 0x64cdd78, add 0x10, store the result as the object's vptr
